question: Which pickup ZIP codes have the most trips?
How does the average fare change by hour of day?
Show total trips and fare revenue by month.

content: This is a historical sample of NYC yellow taxi trips, not current or complete city traffic. Use samples.nyctaxi.trips. Each row represents a trip. fare_amount is the fare in USD, excluding tips and tolls; call SUM(fare_amount) fare revenue. trip_distance is in miles. tpep_pickup_datetime and tpep_dropoff_datetime are source timestamps. pickup_zip and dropoff_zip are postal ZIP codes, not GPS coordinates. Duration in minutes is timestampdiff(SECOND,tpep_pickup_datetime,tpep_dropoff_datetime)/60.0. First inspect MIN and MAX pickup timestamps when a date range is not specified; do not assume current dates. User-specified to dates are inclusive. Do not invent passenger counts, payments, ratings, tips or precise GPS locations, which are absent. Read-only analytics only.
